# Sree Svadista Prasada

> Authentic South Indian restaurant and online food shop serving Milton Keynes, Edinburgh, and Glasgow. Two distinct menus: Svadista (contemporary South Indian) and Prasada (traditional temple-style vegetarian).

## About

Sree Svadista Prasada is an authentic South Indian restaurant based in the UK. We combine the bold, contemporary flavours of Svadista with the pure, traditional vegetarian cooking of Prasada — temple-style food made with no onion, no garlic.

We also offer:
- Breakfast and street food menus
- Ragi (finger millet) specialities
- Snacks, pickles, and podis available for UK-wide shipping
- Dabba Wala weekly meal subscription (UK-wide delivery)
- Catering for events and functions

## Locations

- **Milton Keynes** — Primary dine-in and collection location
- **Edinburgh** — Coming soon
- **Glasgow** — Coming soon

## Menus

- Svadista Menu: Contemporary South Indian cuisine — curries, biryanis, dosas, idlis, vadas
- Prasada Menu: Traditional vegetarian temple food — no onion, no garlic
- Breakfast: South Indian breakfast classics — idli, vada, upma, pongal
- Street Food: Chaat, bhajis, bondas, and more
- Ragi Specials: Finger millet-based healthy dishes and drinks
- Drinks: Fresh juices, lassis, filter coffee, teas

## Ordering & Delivery

Customers can place orders online for collection or delivery. Delivery is available within defined postcodes around each location. Dabba Wala meal plan subscriptions ship UK-wide.

## Customer Accounts

Users can register and log in to:
- Place and track orders
- Manage Dabba Wala subscriptions
- Write reviews on menu items
- Send enquiries and receive replies from staff
- Earn and view loyalty points
